notes: Fixed the Shortcuts preview showing too many tiles per row — it was wrapping based on the Panel Editor's own wide column instead of the real panel's actual width, so it never wrapped where the real panel does.

Root cause was a physical-vs-logical pixel mismatch (the real panel's width is spec'd in physical pixels; a display scaled above 100% renders that as fewer logical/CSS pixels) — the preview now accounts for your display's actual scale, so…
